title: Comunicado 2025-06-26
summary: Banxico cut the policy rate by 50bp to 8.00% by a 4-1 majority, with Heath dissenting for a hold at 8.50%, and kept an explicit easing bias: 'la Junta de Gobierno valorará recortes adicionales'. The cut is justified by the peso's appreciation, the weakness of activity (persistent slack, important downside risks) and the still-prevailing degree of restriction, while the inflation picture deteriorated: headline rose to 4.51%, core to 4.20%, forecasts were revised up and the risk balance stays tilted upward, though less than in 2021-2024. Versus the May communique, which was unanimous and left the door open to another cut of similar magnitude, the Board dropped the 'similar magnitude' reference and the vote split again, so the message is still a large cut with more easing ahead but with a noticeably more cautious guidance.

key_quotes.quote: Hacia delante, la Junta de Gobierno valorará recortes adicionales a la tasa de referencia.
key_quotes.context: Easing bias kept, but without May's reference to a cut of similar magnitude

key_quotes.quote: La Junta de Gobierno juzgó oportuno continuar con la calibración de la postura monetaria. Ello considerando el comportamiento del tipo de cambio, la debilidad de la actividad económica e incluyendo el posible impacto de los cambios de las políticas comerciales a nivel global.
key_quotes.context: Justification for the 50bp cut: peso, weak activity, trade policy

key_quotes.quote: Se considera que el balance de riesgos respecto de la trayectoria prevista para la inflación en el horizonte de pronóstico mantiene un sesgo al alza, si bien este es menos pronunciado que el enfrentado entre 2021 y 2024.
key_quotes.context: Upside risk balance kept after forecasts were revised up

key_quotes.quote: Votó a favor de mantener el objetivo para la Tasa de Interés Interbancaria a un día en un nivel de 8.50% Jonathan Heath.
key_quotes.context: Heath dissents for a hold; the vote is no longer unanimous
